text:
Sanjay: Heads up — noticed a spike in delayed metering events from the realtime router for the 'hot-path' routing policy. Dash shows tokens lagging ~30s for some customers. Anyone else seeing this?

Ada: saw similar in canary — backpressure kicked in and we dropped events to kafka topic 'metering.highpri' (producer logs below). /cc @Kevin
```
WARN router: backpressure applied route=hot-path queue_len=512 flush_ms=1200
ERROR metering-producer: publish timeout topic=metering.highpri err=Timeout
```

Kevin: Investigating — suspect autoscaling on dedicated ingest service didn't spin up due to quota gating. The rollout that touched quota-checker last week might be related. Pulling logs from quota-checker.

Julie: Quick note — the billing dashboard (prod.billing.tokens) uses 1m aggregation. If events delayed >30s they show up as drops in realtime but still make it into batch. UX for alerts is confusing. We should surface lag metric.

Sanjay: Agree. Proposal: add 'metering_event_delay_ms' to console telemetry, and add alert when p95 > 10s for any route. Also add an escalation on retries>3.

Kevin: ok, but adding telemetry increases cardinality. Let's sample 1% by default and 100% for high-priority customers. Thoughts?

Ada: Sampling + tagging route=hot-path should be fine. We also need to ensure dedupe window handles replays (idempotency).

MeteringBot: New event submitted: ticket #3458 'hot-path metering delay' assigned to Kevin. Estimated 3d.

Julie: I'll update dashboard ticket to include a 'delayed events' panel and change alert wording. Also want to add a UI toggle for enabling live lag alerts per org.

Sanjay: Good. Immediate action: rollback quota-checker change in prod? or patch to skip gating on internal ingest? Which is safer?

Kevin: Patch to skip gating is low-risk. Rolling a quick canary now. Will follow up with rollback if metrics don't improve. pinging @ops onstandby.

OpsBot: Canary started: deploy-789 on ingest-prim, routing=hot-path. Watch prod.metrics.metering.ingest_latency.

Kevin: Canary looks good so far — p95 down to 2.3s after patch. Sending PR with sampling + telemetry followups. I'll file follow-ups for dedupe review.
